changes: Preserve all historical results by default until context-budget compaction; retain finite authored count limits, including zero, as opt-in policy.
Keep oversized live previews and full private spills bounded; add 1-indexed Unicode character windows to read so a middle slice of a huge single line remains accessible without shell access.
Track character windows separately from raw line and notebook reads; character windows never establish full-overwrite authority.
Keep bounded spill recovery references in compaction inventory independently of summary prose; treat them as untrusted locations and never as permission grants.

resolved_scenarios: Ninth historical result erased early evidence despite ample context budget.
Private single-line spill exceeded line-read byte cap, so middle evidence could not be inspected through the authorized read tool.
Summary prose omitted recovery path while compaction drained the result record.
residual_risks: Explicit configured count limits intentionally retain their prior pruning semantics.
Compaction inventory remains bounded and reports omitted records; it does not promise unlimited recovery-reference retention.
Failed spill persistence explicitly reports full output unavailable; the context cap remains in force.

new_behavior_cases: Twelve default historical tool results survive Session projection and provider-history replay.
Default context accounting retains complete pressure and triggers compaction rather than silently discounting evidence.
Actual private spill middle recovery, unchanged repeat refusal, changed-content re-read, cross-session denial and no-overwrite authority.
Unicode decoder chunk split, byte cap, EOF, invalid UTF-8 and ambiguous/zero range refusals.
Compaction preserves an untrusted nonexistent spill location without opening it, including serialization and imported classification.
testing.execution: Deferred to parent combined validation to avoid duplicate Cargo builds; cargo fmt and git diff --check passed.
